items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet ruled out with knee injury after being carted off late in TNF win vs Patriots; thumbs up but severity TBD Friday.
items.why: Carted after hard hit on catch near sideline, grabbed knee, ruled out immediately.
items.implication: Elevates Colston Loveland and Luther Burden for remaining snaps/routes/targets in two-TE sets and red zone.
items.opportunity: Loveland already seeing projected usage spike; full TE1 rolee without Kmet.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left Thursday practice early with calf injury; listed limited. Already without Davante Adams (IR, 6-10 weeks).
items.why: Exited early; calf; Friday report critical for Week 7 @ LV.
items.implication: If OUT/limited, targets scatter to Whittington/Atwell/Mumpfield/Higbee; if plays, massive volume.
items.opportunity: Post-Adams, Levitan projects 25 targets/game for Nacua if healthy.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially DNP second straight day (hamstring); needs Friday practice for realistic Week 7 shot vs SEA.
items.why: Hamstring from Week 4; consecutive DNPs post-bye.
items.implication: Worthy/others elevated if OUT; Rice high-upside if returns but risky.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/monitor backups for snap share if inactive.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall back to practice (Thursday injury report); returning from quad.
items.why: Returned after prior absence; positive for availability vs MIA.
items.implication: Restores lead back role; reduces Allen/Davis upside.
items.opportunity: Full workload expected if cleared; monitor snaps.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP (significant); full practices; possible Week 7 debut vs KC after ACL.
items.why: 21-day window ended; full participant Wed/Thu; Macdonald open to snaps.
items.implication: Splits with Walker/Price; reduces sole lead for others; goal-line threat returns.
items.opportunity: Monitor Friday status; committee if plays, but Walker still lead.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility meetings/lifting/medical (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th EPA/rush, Kaleb Johnson 53rd (OL mess too). Long-term outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access positive; backups inefficient EPA data.
items.implication: Jacobs ROS safer if returns soon; fade pure handcuffs short-term.
items.opportunity: Monitor activation; volume returns to Jacobs over poor backups.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs Week 7 due to layoff workload Q.

items.text: Saquon Barkley 'in line' to play MNF vs DAL (RB15 rank); efficient in full games; Dallas top fantasy RB matchup.
items.implication: RB1/2 play if active; volume returns.

items.text: JJ McCarthy starting for Giants vs HOU; YPT to Justin Jefferson only 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9). Small sample/scheme caveats but concerning.
items.why: Historical YPT data with McCarthy lowest by far.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency risk; volume still elite but YPR/YPT drop possible.
items.opportunity: Monitor targets vs completion; fade ceiling slightly.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (Adams beneficiary) recovery 'will take some time' (not ready next week); Rams answer now 25 Puka Nacua targets/game.
items.why: Ferguson delay + Adams IR; historical vacuum fill.
items.implication: Puka mega-volume if healthy (calf now clouds); TE stream lower.
items.opportunity: Puka WR1 overall ceiling ROS with Adams out long.

items.text: Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez active for TNF vs Bears after downgrade to Q (illness).
items.implication: Secondary intact; limited fantasy impact beyond matchup notes for Bears pass catchers.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, Bears good for yardage; 33% target share/97% routes Week 6 despite drops.
items.why: Usage rebound + soft Bears pass D; buying the volume.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high floor/ceiling in TNF-adjacent.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (elite volume), Tucker Kraft @ DET (Lions D gift to PCs), Jaylen Warren @ NO (workload + soft run D).
items.implication: Start with confidence; Kraft TE upside, Warren RB2/flex.
items.opportunity: Lions allow high completion % deep; Warren clear lead.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload Q post-layoff), Rome Odunze vs NE (nasty matchup/role), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D).
items.implication: Sit or lower expectations; Jacobs especially risky Week 7.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive on Jacobs facility access/ROS.

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace: Up - TB@CAR, GB@DET, LAR@LV (high volume). Slogs - MIA@NYJ, others. Free article notes pace/PROE/explosive edges.
items.why: Neutral pace/POE/PROE/explosives data; game environment projections.
items.implication: Stack pass-catchers/RBs in up-pace; avoid volume sinks in slogs.
items.opportunity: Higher combined snaps/points in highlighted games boost all skill players.
